commentary: With the Nifty 50 surrendering critical support at 24,500 amid relentless institutional distribution exceeding ₹80,000 crore and market breadth deteriorating to a weak 23, William O'Neil's cardinal rule applies: three out of four stocks follow general market direction. Stan Weinstein's stage discipline warns that Stage 2 breakouts face elevated failure rates and bull traps when major indices break below key moving averages. Jesse Livermore preached that the real money is made sitting tight when the market tide turns hostile. While select candidates display constructive technical resilience above rising moving averages, Mark Minervini's progressive exposure dictates utmost caution: keep capital preserved, enforce strict pivot stops, and withhold aggressive positioning until market direction confirms accumulation.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

21STCENMGM.technical: Cleared a 20-day high with 1.89x volume expansion, holding above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. MACD confirms upside momentum, though overall micro-cap liquidity demands strict adherence to pivots.
21STCENMGM.fundamental: Jun 2026 revenue surged 194% YoY to ₹10 Cr with ₹9 Cr net profit after consecutive quarterly losses. Despite strong reported margins, volatile investment trading income and negative TTM EPS fail CANSLIM consistency benchmarks.
21STCENMGM.risk: Thesis invalidates on a close below 42.56; immediately cut losses to prevent illiquid micro-cap drawdown.

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Achieved a new 52-week high breakout clearing 20-day resistance with price above 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. Positive MACD shows relative strength against severe broader market distribution.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Stretched P/E above 80x clashes with severe top-line shrinkage (-55% YoY) and net profit contraction (-25% YoY). Sub-6% ROCE and negligible margins fail CANSLIM fundamental criteria.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Thesis fails below 102.59 stop; deteriorating quarterly fundamentals mandate zero tolerance on breakdowns.

ATL.technical: Constructing a double-bottom base above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA on 1.78x volume. RSI at 67 reflects steady accumulation without reaching overbought extremes.
ATL.fundamental: Maintains an asset-light CFS network with reduced borrowings, 29% 3-year ROCE, and 67% promoter holding. However, a 33% YoY Q1 EPS contraction violates CANSLIM acceleration requirements.
ATL.risk: Breakdown below 26.58 invalidates double-bottom base support; exit immediately to preserve capital.

AUSOMENT.technical: Coiling within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot on a 2.76x volume expansion. Price holds firmly above 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA, displaying classic VCP tightening and superior relative strength.
AUSOMENT.fundamental: Bullion refining subsidiary integration catalyzed a 485% revenue surge and 36% EPS expansion to ₹14.76. Negligible debt (D/E 0.05) and 78.7% promoter stake are positive, though 1% OPM warrants monitoring.
AUSOMENT.risk: Thesis fails below 149.34 pivot; tight stop discipline required given commodity trading volatility.

AVADHSUGAR.technical: Carving a double bottom inside a tight 14% flag after a 101% advance. Price remains intact above the 21 EMA and 50 SMA with positive MACD momentum.
AVADHSUGAR.fundamental: Backed by K.K. Birla Group, Q1 net profit rebounded from a low base, but revenue growth (+9% YoY) misses the CANSLIM 15% threshold. Debt-to-equity at 1.25 reflects ongoing cyclical capital demands.
AVADHSUGAR.risk: Setup invalidates on close below 923.01 flag low; cut losses promptly given sugar commodity beta.

BIL.technical: Bullish double bottom retesting neckline support, confirmed by a long lower wick rejection and RSI at 61. Alignment above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA reflects Stage 2 durability.
BIL.fundamental: Strong export demand drove 33% revenue growth and 210% EPS expansion to ₹13.21. ROCE stands at 16.9% with 61.2% unpledged promoter holding, though global discretionary fashion spending demands ongoing monitoring.
BIL.risk: Breaching 1058.41 stop invalidates double-bottom neckline support; execute immediate stop discipline.
